name: mcp-jp
description: 日本の SaaS 向け MCP サーバー（mcp-jp）の主力コネクタを、スキルつきのプラグインとして配布します。

plugins.name: mcp-jp-smarthr
plugins.description: SmartHR の従業員・部署・雇用形態・役職を調べ、従業員情報を部分更新する（SmartHR 用 MCP サーバーとスキル）。Look up SmartHR employees, departments, employment types and job titles, and update employee records (department transfers, name, email). Read-only except one partial-update tool, which asks for confirmation before writing.

plugins.name: mcp-jp-kingtime
plugins.description: KING OF TIME の従業員・勤怠・打刻・休暇を調べ、打刻を登録する（KING OF TIME 用 MCP サーバーとスキル）。Look up KING OF TIME employees, daily and monthly attendance, time stamps and leave, and record time stamps. Recording a stamp is not idempotent, so the skill checks existing stamps before writing.

plugins.name: mcp-jp-smaregi
plugins.description: スマレジの商品・取引・会員・店舗・在庫を調べる（スマレジ 用 MCP サーバーとスキル）。Look up Smaregi POS products, transactions, customers, stores and stock levels through the Smaregi Platform API. Useful for sales checks, stock checks and store-level summaries.

plugins.name: mcp-jp-cloudsign
plugins.description: クラウドサインの書類・契約情報を調べ、契約書を作成・送信する（クラウドサイン 用 MCP サーバーとスキル）。Look up CloudSign documents and contract attributes, and create, address and send contracts for e-signature. Sending cannot be undone, so the skill shows the title and recipients and asks for explicit confirmation first.
